trigger: Pipeline-state integrity check C3 fails on master for story tfhc-s1
summary: scripts/check-pipeline-state-integrity.js rule C3 fails for tfhc-s1 (feature 2026-10-30-test-fixture-hardening-continuation): prStatus is "merged" but testPlan.passing (4) is below testPlan.totalTests (5). The story was merged with one test unaccounted for and the state was never corrected. Knowingly left unfixed; this is the only failure the integrity check reports on master.
revisitCondition: Act when testPlan.passing for tfhc-s1 is corrected to the confirmed passing count in a post-merge pipeline-state commit, or when the C3 check itself is changed to tolerate it.

trigger: Governed documents disagree on whether an enterprise fork is a supported distribution path
summary: Architecture guardrails constraint C1 (the update channel must never be severed; fork-requiring distribution is off the table) contradicts skills/bootstrap/SKILL.md Step 3d Option C ("Enterprise fork") and the "Enterprise with org fork" flow in docs/skill-pipeline-instructions.md, which offer an org-level fork as a first-class onboarding path. Found by a read-only audit on 2026-11-08 and deliberately not resolved at the time.
revisitCondition: deferred to a broader `product/` refresh later

trigger: Deleting a product fails when one of its journeys has artefacts
summary: On wuce-staging, 2026-11-18, DELETE /products/:id threw a foreign key violation: update or delete on table journeys violates artefacts_journey_id_fkey on table artefacts (handleDeleteProduct, routes/products.js line 3438). The handler deletes journeys but not their artefacts, so any product with a started feature that has an artefact cannot be deleted. The page showed only Failed to delete product. Found while driving a staging walkthrough; the error reached the error capture chain via authGuard but the error bridge ignores staging, so no issue or incident was opened.
triageSummary: No relevant prior incident was found for this record's tags.
